_comment: FR-001 (secrets-environment-scope): curated environment-folder tier groups for the Secrets page. Hand-maintained by Platform Engineering as new apps/environments are onboarded, same convention as data/environments.json/data/modules.json/data/roles.json. Matching is case-insensitive. Any environment folder name not listed in 'production' or 'nonProduction' resolves to tier 'unclassified' (rendered under the 'Other' UI group) — 'other' below is documentation of known-but-neither-tier names, not a distinct functional bucket.
